pull.title: jobs: add negotiated cancellation for active orders
pull.body:
## Summary
- add a dedicated cancellation-request aggregate for active `IN_PROGRESS` jobs
- allow either participant to request cancellation with a reason
- require the counterparty to approve or decline; requester can withdraw but cannot self-approve
- atomically cancel the job, stop location sharing and refund held escrow only after counterparty approval
- emit participant notifications for requested/approved/declined/withdrawn transitions
- enforce one pending request per job and resolution-shape constraints in Flyway V16
- expose the full negotiated-cancellation flow in the job details UI with reason entry, pending state, approve/decline and withdraw actions
- cover the service rules with unit tests and a dedicated PostgreSQL/Docker smoke that verifies self-approval rejection, cancellation, full escrow refund and terminal tracking cleanup

## Safety / lifecycle rules
- direct cancellation of accepted jobs remains forbidden
- negotiated cancellation is limited to `IN_PROGRESS`; `COMPLETION_REQUESTED` continues through confirmation/dispute so cancellation cannot bypass completion settlement
- DB uniqueness prevents concurrent duplicate pending requests
- the job row is pessimistically locked before cancellation mutations
- master V15 keeps the database terminal-state tracking trigger as defense-in-depth without mutating the JPA optimistic-lock version; the application also publishes the stopped tracking state
- approval is transactional: if refund or tracking cleanup fails, the cancellation mutation rolls back

## Validation
CI is the merge gate. Do not merge unless API tests/build, web lint/build, general runtime checks, payments ledger smoke and the dedicated cancellation smoke pass.
